messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Service error rate spike detected
service: inference-api
endpoint: POST /v1/generate
region: us-west-2
metric: 5xx_rate
value: 6.8% (baseline 0.5%)
links: https://grafana.redwood/example-dashboard

Maya Patel (on-call): seeing the page. acknowledging and starting triage. paging Alex now.

Maya Patel (on-call): @Alex can you take this? 5xx spike in us-west-2, looks across models. customers reporting timeouts and gateway errors.

Alex Chen (sre): on it. pulling logs and rate-limit metrics. first glance: 429s spiked ~10m before 5xx increase. looks like client retries caused backend saturation.

Priya Sharma (eng): fyi we had a quota rollout last night for tenant-throttles in prod; might be related. which quota keys are being tripped?

Alex Chen (sre): querying redis rate-limiter counts now. command: `redis-cli -h rl-prod-1 --scan | xargs -L1 redis-cli GET` (truncated)

Alex Chen (sre): metrics: global_token_bucket_full_count up 8x. top offending key = `tenant:acct-781:route:/v1/generate`. 429s -> clients retrying, proxy + worker queues filled -> 504s and 502s from gateway.

Maya Patel (on-call): impact list: multiple mid-market customers reporting elevated errors, 3 support P1s opened (Sam can confirm). Estimated affected requests: ~30% of peak in us-west-2 for last 12m.

Sam Ortega (support): confirmed. customers A and B reported degraded service and increased latencies; one started automatic retry/backoff which made it worse. support has notified customers and opened tickets.

Priya Sharma (eng): what's the rate-limit config change? did the rollout change burst allowances?

Alex Chen (sre): yes — last-night deploy tightened `requests_per_minute` for non-verified tenants and introduced a new shared bucket behavior to prevent noisy neighbors. rollout ID: `rl-rollout-2026-03-14`. Canary looked fine but global volume changed due to a marketing spike.

Maya Patel (on-call): ok mitigation plan: 1) temporarily relax quota for impacted tenants 2) throttle retries at edge 3) enable fallback routing to dedicated model pool for critical customers 4) if needed, scale up worker pool. Thoughts?

Priya Sharma (eng): agree. quick change: revert shared-bucket behavior gate — patch ID `rl-revert-2026-03-14`. I can deploy a hotfix to flip the flag. Alex can you whitelist critical tenant keys to avoid 429 cascade?

Alex Chen (sre): starting whitelist: `SETEX tenant:acct-781:rl-exempt 1 3600` and for top 10 tenants. running now.

incident-bot: action_log: Alex set temporary exempts for 10 tenants (task id 8921).

Maya Patel (on-call): Priya, go ahead with the revert. include a small canary for 5 mins then global. post the deploy link here.

Priya Sharma (eng): deploying `rl-revert-2026-03-14` to prod canary now. CI run passed.

Priya Sharma (eng): canary at 5% -> monitoring error rate.

Alex Chen (sre): while canary runs, I'm inserting a short-lived rate-limit header at the edge to reduce aggressive client retries: config change `proxy.retry-after-header: true` and reduce `max-retries` from 3 -> 1 for external clients. Pushing now.

Maya Patel (on-call): good. also enabling additional worker instances in us-west-2: `k scale deployment inference-workers --replicas=+6 -n prod-usw2`

incident-bot: k8s: scaled inference-workers from 12 -> 18 in prod-usw2 (triggered by Maya).

Alex Chen (sre): canary looks promising: 5xx down from 6.8% -> 1.2% in canary region. global rollout in progress.

Priya Sharma (eng): rollback flag rolled out to 100% across prod.

Maya Patel (on-call): telemetry showing 429s dropping, 5xx declining. still watchful for flapping. Sam, please update support tickets and customer comms: we believe cause was an aggressive quota config + retry amplification; temporary mitigations applied.

Sam Ortega (support): updating now. sending proactive note to affected customers and CS.

Priya Sharma (eng): quick note for post-incident: we need guardrails for quota rollouts (blast radius controls) and automated detection of 429->5xx cascading patterns. adding to action items.

Alex Chen (sre): remediation summary so far:
- Temporary exempts applied to top-ten tenants
- Reverted shared-bucket quota change (rl-revert-2026-03-14)
- Reduced edge retry aggressiveness and added Retry-After header
- Scaled inference-workers in us-west-2

Maya Patel (on-call): current status: service error rate back to baseline ~0.4%. I'm keeping this thread open for 30m to watch for regressions.

Priya Sharma (eng): logging task for root cause: investigate canary coverage vs production traffic profiles; reproduce in staging with high-concurrency bursts.

Alex Chen (sre): created incident ticket INC-2026-0314-01 and assigned owners: Priya (root cause), Alex (mitigation engineering), Maya (postmortem lead), Sam (customer comms).

incident-bot: pages: none outstanding. next on-call: @Maya at 1800 UTC for handoff unless otherwise.

Maya Patel (on-call): handoff note for next on-call: watch for any 429 resurfacing, watch redis RL saturated keys, retention: keep exempts for 1h then evaluate.

Sam Ortega (support): customers acknowledged the update and appreciate the quick action. one asks for ETA on permanent fix. I told them we'll follow up after RCA.

Priya Sharma (eng): action items (short):
- PR: add quota rollout blast-radius checks and staged traffic simulation (owner: Priya)
- PR: add 429->5xx alert rule to grafana (owner: Alex)
- Run customer impact replay to find any missed tenants (owner: Sam)

Maya Patel (on-call): thanks everyone. closing escalation phase. will open postmortem thread and link to this conversation.

Alex Chen (sre): one more: let's ensure alert has runbook link to rate-limiter docs: `doc/rate-limits.md` — updating alert.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. final metrics: peak 5xx 6.8% -> current 0.4%.

Maya Patel (on-call): timestamping end of active mitigation: 1765001567.
